themes.title: A held change stays held after the user fixes its cause
themes.why: After 'Match it' → matching the item, the Events row still says 'Item not matched', Held stays 1 and Mappings says 'Every product is matched.' Nothing says Retry is still needed, so the +12 never reaches Shopify.
themes.fix: After a mapping that fixes a held change: toast '1 held change can be sent now · Retry'; the Events row reads 'Matched · ready to send' with an inline Retry.

themes.title: 'Ready' and a vanished banner read as 'done' while sync is still off
themes.why: When location + setting are done the banner disappears and the badge says Ready; Enable sits in another column (KF-2 pattern).
themes.fix: While sync is off and a store is ready: banner 'My ceramic plates is ready. Enable sync to start sending stock changes.' with Enable inside; badge 'Ready · sync off'.

themes.title: 'Created product should be: Inventory' never says what it changes
themes.why: Switching to Inventory makes products Synder creates in QuickBooks Inventory items, whose sales post Cost of Goods Sold and use an Inventory Asset account. Users can't tell what happens to their books.
themes.fix: Keep the exact setting name; add one helper line: 'Products Synder creates in QuickBooks will be Inventory items, so their sales post Cost of Goods Sold.' + Learn more. (Needs product to confirm existing items are untouched.)

themes.title: Two sentences that mislead about what sync does
themes.why: 'Only changes made after you enable are sent' doesn't say existing differences stay; 'won't sync' means 'won't reach the books' in Synder's own vocabulary.
themes.fix: 'Stock that already differs stays as it is — see Stock check.' and '1 product has no QuickBooks item, so its stock changes won't be sent to Shopify.'

themes.title: Accept QuickBooks dialog promises a total but sends a difference
themes.why: 'will be set to 140 (change +8)' — the +8 is from the last comparison; if stock moved since, Shopify won't end at 140. 'on hand', 'sync event' are jargon.
themes.fix: 'Synder sends +8 to Shopify so Ceramic plate 24cm goes from 132 to 140 (difference at the last comparison, 02:30 UTC). Compare now first if stock moved since.'

themes.title: 'Connect store' is the strongest button during setup
themes.why: It is the only filled button while the required fixes are small outlined ones, and later it competes with Enable.
themes.fix: Outlined 'Connect store' once a store exists.

themes.title: Stock check count ≠ Reconcile list; Ignore has no undo
themes.why: Block says 2 (stores with a location) but Reconcile lists 3 (includes the store without a location). Ignore acts at once with no way back.
themes.fix: Reconcile skips stores without a location too; add Undo to Ignore (toast + row).

gaps: Help ? tooltips not recorded by recon (they exist as title attributes)
